This template is to be used for citing individual stories published within issues of the [[2020]] [[Star Wars Adventures (2020)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] anthology [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] by [[IDW Publishing]].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, paste it into the appropriate place in an article, and fill in the required fields.

<code><nowiki>{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=|special=|story=|stext=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*One of the following:
**'''issue''': Number of the issue being cited.
**'''issue1''' and '''issue2''': Issue numbers for multi-part stories
**'''annual''': Year of the annual issue being cited.
*'''story''': Name of the story being cited.

===Optional parameters===
*'''stext''': Formatted name of the story being cited.

===Examples===
<code><nowiki>
{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=1|issue2=2|story=The Obstacle Course}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=1|issue2=2|story=The Obstacle Course}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|annual=2020|story=Rabbit Hunt}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|annual=2020|story=Rabbit Hunt}}

==See also==
For pages relating to the [[2017]] ''[[Star Wars Adventures (2017)|Star Wars Adventures]]'' series, use {{Tl|IDWAdventuresCite-2017}}.
